newsitem.title: GERMANY: Rheinmetall willing to talk on Kolbenschmidt to T&N.
newsitem.headline: Rheinmetall willing to talk on Kolbenschmidt to T&N.

text.p: German defence and engineering group Rheinmetall AG said on Friday it was still willing to talk to Britain's T&N Plc over German car component supplier Kolbenschmidt AG.
"We have spoken to T&N about Kolbenschmidt and we shall speak to them again. Our mind is open and we are looking to find a solution to this," a Rheinmetall spokesman said in response to enquiries.

He denied an earlier comment by a spokesman for Kolbenschmidt, in which Rheinmetall is buying a 24.99 percent stake, that suggestions that Rheinmetall might cooperate with T&N were "wishful thinking" and that Rheinmetall had ruled out any such possibility.
Rheinmetall willing to talk on Kolbenschmidt to T&N

He noted however that Rheinmetall's goal, as stated on Wednesday when it announced plans to purchase a stake in Kolbenschmidt, was still to gain a majority interest and with it management control of the firm.
T&N retains options on a separate 24.99 percent stake in Kolbenschmidt but has so far been prevented from taking up the stake by the German Federal Cartel Office.
Rheinmetall's intervention this week was initially interpreted as spelling the end to T&N's long-standing ambitions on Kolbenschmidt.

But industry sources later suggested that Rheinmetall's move might yet prove friendly to T&N's own quest to combine its pistons business with that of Kolbenschmidt, with some mooting a joint venture as possible.
